poems.title: OUT OF LIFE
poems.full_verse: What we've made, we don't want. What we've sold — to the world, to ourselves — doesn't exist. I look for a way out: through the hallways, within the drawers, and fire escapes. The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away. More haze. What isn't mine, I still can not give.

legos.location_L: Domestic Apartment Hallways, Drawers, Fire Escapes & Misty Bedroom Window.
legos.goal_G: Finding a Way Out — Seeking an authentic exit from manufactured pretenses, false commodities, and domestic stasis.
legos.obstacle_O: Suffocating Domestic Haze & Emotional Drift — Vape smoke and detachment blurring vision as the partner moves further away.
legos.shift_S: Moving toward the window only for the distance between lovers to widen into an impenetrable haze.
legos.solution_U: Severing False Obligations — Acknowledging the departure and accepting: 'What isn't mine, I still can not give.'

poems.title: FLASHING LIGHTS
poems.full_verse: It was the type of silent scream a trapped lover makes to escape: a pending marriage, a concussion, a set of walls caving inward. An emergency call while tossing and turning — the silent call a man makes to the mirror after midnight, to digest a truth. A truth he could neither alter nor change. What isn't mine, I still can not give.

legos.location_L: Midnight Insomnia Bedroom with Caving Walls & Solitary Bathroom Mirror.
legos.entity_E: The Trapped Lover / Conflicted Man Facing His Reflection.
legos.goal_G: Digesting the Unspoken Truth — Escaping the claustrophobic pressure of an impending marriage and internal concussion.
legos.obstacle_O: Caving Walls & Tossing Insonmia — The paralyzing dread of breaking a social commitment and causing pain.
legos.shift_S: The silent call made directly into the mirror after midnight during an emergency psychological crisis.
legos.solution_U: Solitary Confrontation — Facing the mirror to admit the unalterable truth that love cannot be forced.

poems.title: HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT
poems.full_verse: Ode to forever — a tambourine sounds off an empty temple, empty choir stands, empty prayer lines. And abandoned baptism pools. It flies in through the rose window — still whole. A broken promise.

legos.location_L: Abandoned Sacred Sanctuary — Empty choir stands, deserted prayer lines, dry baptism pools, and stained-glass rose window.
legos.entity_E: The Betrothed Soul Severing the Lifelong Vow.
legos.goal_G: Graceful Dissolution of the Vow — Releasing the heavy mantle of 'forever' without shattering his inner spirit.
legos.obstacle_O: Sanctified Permanence — The immense moral and spiritual weight of empty altars and ceremonial expectations.
legos.shift_S: A lone tambourine vibrates off empty temple walls, and memory flies unbroken through the stained-glass rose window.
legos.solution_U: Sacred Release — Acknowledging that the sanctuary is empty, allowing the broken promise to rest whole without guilt.

poems.title: NEVERMORE
poems.full_verse: What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore — and the ashes of expired wildfires cover sands, and debris lifted from the night sea water's floor. The waves calm to folded whispers; the winds mute the trees. The right level of silence, to find a throbbing heart — it used to be mine. I lift it with care: nevermore.

legos.location_L: Night Ocean Shoreline — Wildfire ashes over sand and ancient debris washed ashore from the seabed.
legos.entity_E: The Shoreline Wanderer / Recoverer of the Lost Heart.
legos.goal_G: Reclaiming the Lost Heart — Tracking washed-up wreckage to locate and salvage his former capacity for feeling.
legos.obstacle_O: Wildfire Ashes & Sea Debris — The desolate wreckage of past burns and the roar of ocean waves obscuring the heart.
legos.shift_S: Waves calm to folded whispers and winds mute the trees, producing the exact silence needed to hear the heart throbbing in the sand.
legos.solution_U: Sacred Reclamation — Lifting the recovered beating heart with delicate care and sealing the boundary: 'nevermore.'

poems.title: BLOODLINES
poems.full_verse: Now go, they tell me. To ask if I can inherit the earth — to ask if I can name my own stars. Even galaxies, if I may. The past, too, was waiting for me — coming of age in the shared rooms of humid basements as bedrooms; mattress pads where the wood beams of Southern pine could comfort my spine. It didn't. To dream was to prevail.

legos.location_L: Shared Humid Southern Basement Bedroom & Deep Galactic Starfield.
legos.entity_E: The Young Lineage Heir / Galactic Dreamer.
legos.goal_G: Inheriting the Earth & Naming Galaxies — Transcending the physical poverty and bone-aches of his origins.
legos.obstacle_O: Humid Basement Walls & Rigid Pine Beams — Unyielding wood beams that offered no comfort to his growing spine.
legos.shift_S: Realizing that dreaming was not an escape, but the foundational act of prevalence that unlocked cosmic sovereignty.
legos.solution_U: Interstellar Sovereign Lineage — Claiming the power to name galaxies while honoring the unbreakable spine built in the basement.

poems.title: RESURRECTING ATLANTIS
poems.full_verse: Poets, who eased generations down yellow brick roads — and plucked our souls out of their secret places, to follow comets to the capital city of our collective consciousness. Resurrecting Atlantis. Here we are all one — the pact we've made here with nature, abandoned and hoped for the best, back on life.

legos.location_L: The Capital City of Collective Consciousness / Submerged Atlantis Resurrected.
legos.entity_E: The Lineage of Poets & The United Human Collective.
legos.goal_G: Resurrecting Atlantis — Following comet trails to reunite fragmented human souls back into harmony with the natural world.
legos.obstacle_O: Generational Amnesia & Abandoned Ecological Pact — The historical severance from nature and lost collective memory.
legos.shift_S: Poets pluck hidden souls from their secret shelters, guiding them along cosmic yellow brick roads into unified awareness.
legos.solution_U: Universal Oneness — 'Here we are all one' — restoring the sacred pact with life across the resurrected collective matrix.

poems.title: DJ TURN ME UP
poems.full_verse: DJ, turn me up, please. Eyes wide shut, chin nested at the arch of the weight of these spoken words. I have a love story to tell — of ghosts, whispering unfolded dilutions, birthed in purity, and dying in the vineyards of sun-soaked evergreen fields, unnourished.

legos.location_L: Subterranean Soundstage Booth & Unnourished Sun-Soaked Evergreen Vineyards.
legos.entity_E: The Spoken Word Lyricist & The DJ.
legos.goal_G: Amplifying the Unspoken Ghost Story — Channeling acoustic power to testify to pure love that withered unnourished.
legos.obstacle_O: Suffocating Weight of Words & Ghostly Dilutions — The crushing heaviness of unexpressed grief dying in silent fields.
legos.shift_S: Calling out 'DJ, turn me up, please' with eyes wide shut, nesting chin at the microphone arch to release the narrative.
legos.solution_U: Acoustic Catharsis — Transforming silent ghostly sorrow into an amplified, undeniable sonic broadcast.

poems.title: NEWLY SINGLE
poems.full_verse: Pulsing, and head throbbing from the music — and empty, on a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations. The soul escapes my body, and leaves him on the dance floor — just flesh and bones. Rejection and heartache hit different, with no feelings afloat.

legos.location_L: Sweated, Crowded Nightclub Dance Floor Lit by Throbbing Bass.
legos.entity_E: The Newly Single Man (Bifurcated into Dancing Flesh and Ascending Soul).
legos.goal_G: Surviving Post-Breakup Heartache — Navigating sensual distractions while emotionally hollowed out.
legos.obstacle_O: Throbbing Music, Temptation, & Acute Rejection — The suffocating crush of dancing bodies pressing against inner numbness.
legos.shift_S: The soul detaches and floats upward out of the physical body, leaving an empty vessel of flesh and bones on the floor.
legos.solution_U: Anesthetized Elevation — Overcoming heartbreak by floating above sensation, surviving with zero emotional drag.

poems.title: YET, HEARD
poems.full_verse: Before I go, we look at the moon the way we used to see it. We talk for years, travel through time — we grow old together, I believe. Before I go, I call on my mother — in tears, speaking of an abyss she's never known. Before I go, I call on my father — his calming demeanor summoned from the yonders. We stroll, father and son, hearted and shaken. Someone borrowed, and someone blue — yet, broken. Yet, heard.

legos.location_L: Moonlit Harbor Horizon & Wave Shadows of the Inner Bay.
legos.entity_E: The Departing Son Reconnecting with Mother & Father.
legos.goal_G: Ancestral Reconciliation Before Departure — Summoning parental presence to explain his wounds and seek peace.
legos.obstacle_O: The Unbridgeable Abyss — Wounds his mother has never known and tears falling in the dark harbor waves.
legos.shift_S: Walking east toward the sunrise with his father, retracing generational footsteps while weeping in the harbor shadows.
legos.solution_U: Heard Across the Void — Strolling together as father and son: broken, blue, yet profoundly and undeniably heard.

poems.title: MAGIC RIDE
poems.full_verse: I wasn't looking for a ride, but here you are — blissful, and oddly sensitive. I rub my aggressions into your steel coverings, and hop on. Loneliness is having everything with no one to tell — being everywhere, with no one to love. I let the noise block the noise. The way I ride: eyes turn, heads twist — and prove the magic still exists. The moon settles, and I can see a morning ahead for me.

legos.location_L: Open Steel Motorcycle on Coastal Highway Transitioning into Dawn.
legos.entity_E: The Solitary Rider on the Steel Machine.
legos.goal_G: Proving Magic Still Exists — Drowning out isolation and aggressions through the roar of machine velocity.
legos.obstacle_O: Profound Loneliness — Having everything with no one to tell, being everywhere with no one to love.
legos.shift_S: Letting the mechanical noise block the psychic noise, leaning into the throttle until heads twist and the morning appears.
legos.solution_U: Awakened Morning — Darkness and distant stars subside, revealing a crisp morning of authentic hope and living magic.

poems.title: NEW DAY
poems.full_verse: Fog covers the seas and hugs the tree-covered hills, floating through the morning as it exhales its introduction. This world is at peace. In the awakening of dawn, in fresh muted colors: we can rebuild this temple. It's a new day — a catharsis for me to say, with newfound energies and recycled airs. Edgeless dreams that reflect the skies... that we too can walk on water.

legos.location_L: Morning Hillside Forest Overlooking Coastal Seas & Infinite Edgeless Reflection Pools.
legos.goal_G: Rebuilding the Temple & Claiming Catharsis — Welcoming a peaceful new day with fresh creative energies.
legos.obstacle_O: Past Destructions & Lingering Sea Fog — The historical ruins of previous temples and residual exhaustion.
legos.shift_S: Dawn breaks in muted pastels as morning dews and vibrant sun rays illuminate the edgeless waters.
legos.solution_U: Miraculous Renewal — Taking deep appreciative breaths of present life: 'We can rebuild this temple... we too can walk on water.'

poems.title: REUNION
poems.full_verse: Decades later, there is less time for words, and more space for laughter — hugs with no reason, and loud voices, so our hearts can be overheard. Reflecting on legacies, and creeds once told — of elders, now past. Or will we make time, in the sands of burning hourglasses? Before our winds part ways — to a next lifetime. This is brotherhood.

legos.location_L: Sanctuary of Burning Hourglasses & Winds of Legacy.
legos.entity_E: Reunited Brothers / Kinship Descendants of Departed Elders.
legos.goal_G: Making Time for Brotherhood — Overcoming decades of separation to celebrate shared survival.
legos.obstacle_O: The Burning Hourglass & Inevitable Mortality — The rapid passage of time threatening to scatter their winds.
legos.shift_S: Abandoning formal words in favor of loud voices, unreasoned hugs, and full-bodied laughter so hearts are overheard.
legos.solution_U: Sacred Brotherhood — Forging a triumphant bond that defies time and echoes into the next lifetime.

poems.title: HOW TO WIN MY HEART
poems.full_verse: Find me at the harbor, at the small tables, watching. The couples orbit each other the way Jupiter keeps its moons — close, and counted. Life has burned all my love stories — victory-less seasons. So I harvest the flowers instead — scarlet poppies, purple blossoms — and they become my power. Then, a distant window. She says: you'll see me. Capture the eyes. Refocus. Step back. Say hello. Don't make me leave. I escaped here for a reason.

legos.location_L: Seaside Harbor Small Tables & Distant Window Looking Over the Bay.
legos.entity_E: The Guarded Harbor Watcher & The Distant Muse.
legos.goal_G: Protecting Inner Power While Opening to Love — Navigating romantic curiosity after repeated past heartbreak.
legos.obstacle_O: Victory-Less Seasons & Past Ashes — All prior love stories burned, creating fear of leaving his harbor refuge.
legos.shift_S: Harvesting scarlet poppies and purple blossoms into personal power, then catching her gaze in a distant window.
legos.solution_U: Refocused Vulnerability — Stepping back, capturing the eyes, and choosing to say hello without abandoning his sanctuary.

poems.title: HOT MINUTE
poems.full_verse: A hot minute. The haze gathers on the water — and everything I built here learns to be weather: the city, the temple, the harbor. It takes me last, and from the ground up. I am reluctant — but I have been weather before. All black again. But no walls this time. A life flashes the way a reel does: the window, the tambourine, the field, the stars, the candle, the daisy, the ride, the temple, the hourglass. Our dance together is a victory. An old door, from a vintage somewhere. It opens on a slow party — the kind I once fell out of a window to escape. This time, I choose the door.

legos.location_L: Atmospheric Dissolution Shoreline (City, Temple, Harbor Becoming Weather) & Vintage Doorway.
legos.goal_G: Conscious Narrative Transcendence — Allowing the built world to dissolve into weather and choosing his exit with dignity.
legos.obstacle_O: Reluctance to Dissolve & Darkness — The terrifying collapse of all physical structures into black void.
legos.shift_S: Life flashes like a film reel (window, tambourine, ride, temple, hourglass); what was once a traumatic escape becomes a dance of victory.
legos.solution_U: Choosing the Door — Rather than falling out of a window to escape, consciously and calmly walking through the door into the gathering.
